name: Mu Guiying
description: Mu Guiying, an outstanding heroine in ancient China, is famous for her loyalty to the country. As a female general of the Yang family, she is loyal and dedicated to serving the country. The Tianmen formation was surrounded by dangers, and she bravely took command, went deep into the dangerous situation, and annihilated the Liao army; during the southern rebellion, her beauty wrapped up her military uniform, fought bloody battles, and made great achievements; when her husband was trapped in Jinshan during the Western Expedition, she still wore the seal of vanguard at the age of fifty-three, fought against the generals, and finally died for the country. Mu Guiying dedicated her life to protecting her family and country and became a model praised by future generations.
